title: Member of Technical Staff
description: Member of Technical Staff — Mindra Istanbul · On-site · Full-time ABOUT MINDRA Mindra builds budget-aware AI agents for B2C advertisers. Our agents connect ad accounts, attribution, store, and revenue data, then manage budgets across platforms against what actually matters: real store performance, not platform-reported vanity metrics. Teams of agents continuously rebalance and refine cross-platform campaigns to improve efficiency and ROAS. We operate across the US and Turkey and serve customers in 8 countries. We're a small founding team. The person in this seat will shape how our product, our agents, and our engineering culture work for years. THE PROBLEMS YOU'LL WORK ON • Ad platform integrations at scale. Pulling, normalizing, and acting on data from Meta, Google, and other ad platform APIs, including rate limits, schema changes, delayed conversions, and all the mess that comes with them. • Attribution that reflects reality. Reconciling what ad platforms report with what actually happened in the store and in revenue data, and deciding which signal to trust when they disagree. • Budget allocation under uncertainty. Deciding where the next dollar should go across campaigns and platforms, with noisy, lagged, and incomplete data. • Agents that touch real money. Designing agent orchestration, guardrails, and evals for systems that change live budgets for real businesses, where a bad decision has a real cost. • Models of our own. Forecasting, performance prediction, and optimization models that go beyond prompting an LLM. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO • Build across the entire stack: frontend (Next.js/TypeScript), backend (Python), infra (AWS), data pipelines, and the AI layer (agent orchestration, RAG, evals, model routing). Not "full-stack" as a buzzword. You'll touch all of it in a single week. • Train, evaluate, and ship ML models into production, and know when a simple heuristic beats a model. • Own features end to end. You'll take things from "this is broken" or "we need this" through design and shipping, and you'll be on call when it breaks at 3am. • Talk to customers directly. You'll sit with advertisers, understand how they think about spend and returns, and debug with them yourself, without a PM in between. • Make foundational architecture calls. The codebase is small, so what you write now is what everything else gets built on. • Stay on the edge of AI tooling. The space changes weekly. You're already the person who tries a new model the day it drops. WHAT YOU MUST HAVE • Startup experience. You've worked at an early-stage startup or built your own company. You know what it's like when there's no playbook, no spec, and no one else to fix it. • Adtech or performance marketing experience. You've worked with ad platform APIs (Meta, Google, TikTok, etc.), attribution, conversion tracking, or marketing data. You know what ROAS, CPA, and attribution windows mean, and why the numbers never quite match. • 2–3 years of real building. That can be full-time roles, or internships plus serious side projects. Titles don't matter to us. • No silos. You've shipped frontend, written backend, deployed on AWS, and integrated an LLM into something real. "That's not my area" isn't in your vocabulary. • You build without being asked. A side project, a tool you wrote because something annoyed you, a hackathon project that actually worked. We want to see what you make when nobody's telling you to. • Bias to ship. A working version today beats a perfect one next week. You're allergic to over-planning. WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU STAND OUT • You've trained your own models. Not just called an API: you've prepared data, trained, evaluated, and deployed a model yourself, and can explain the trade-offs you made. • Experience with forecasting, recommendation, bandits, or optimization problems. • Familiarity with marketing measurement: incrementality testing, MMM, or multi-touch attribution. • Experience with e-commerce or store data and how it connects to ad performance. • You've built agentic systems and have opinions about evals, tool use, and failure modes. LOGISTICS • Location: Istanbul, on-site • Pace: 996: long days, six days a week. If that sounds like hell, this isn't for you. If it sounds like the most fun you'll ever have building, talk to us. HOW TO APPLY Send us something you've built (a repo, a demo, or a link) and a few lines on why Mindra. If you've worked on adtech or trained your own models, tell us about it, including what went wrong.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Masraff'ta Forward Deployed Engineer Arıyoruz! Masraff Agentic Finance yapıyor. Ürünümüzün değeri, müşterimizin gerçek süreçlerinde çalıştığı an ortaya çıkıyor. Bu anı en hızlı ve en doğru şekilde yaratacak bir ekip arkadaşı arıyoruz. Bize göre Forward Deployed Engineer; müşteriyle yakın çalışır, Masraff'ı müşterinin sistemlerine kurar, canlıya alır ve canlıdaki ek talepleri çözer. Yeni teknolojileri gerçek müşteri ortamlarında uygular, sahada öğrendikleriyle ürüne yön verir. Bu Rolden Beklentilerimiz: - Yeni müşterilerin kurulumunu keşiften canlıya ve devire kadar yönetmek. - Masraff'ı müşterinin ERP, muhasebe, İK ve banka/kart sistemleriyle entegre etmek (REST API, webhook, SFTP, SAP vb.). - Masraf politikalarını, onay akışlarını ve kullanıcı rollerini müşteriye göre yapılandırmak. - Canlıdaki müşterilerin ek taleplerini ve hatalarını hızla çözmek. - Kabul kriterlerini ölçülebilir şekilde tanımlamak, UAT ve demo süreçlerini yürütmek. - Talep karşılama, kurulum ve hata çözümünde yapay zekâ agent'larını kullanmak ve geliştirmek. - Tekrar eden talepleri işaretleyip ürünleştirme sürecine taşımak. Kimler Başvurmalı? Şu şartlara uyuyorsan seni dinlemek isteriz: - Yazılım geliştirme, entegrasyon ya da teknik çözüm alanında en az 2 yıl deneyimin varsa, - API entegrasyonu, SQL ve en az bir programlama dilinde (Python, TypeScript veya C#) rahat çalışıyorsan, - Kurumsal müşterilerle doğrudan çalıştıysan ve teknik bir konuyu teknik olmayan paydaşa sade anlatabiliyorsan, - Talep edilen ile asıl ihtiyacı ayırabiliyorsan; her talebe "evet" demeden kapsamı netleştiriyorsan, - Yapay zekâ araçlarını günlük işinde aktif kullanıyorsan ve kurulum ile hata çözümünü otomatikleştirmek istiyorsan, - Test, doğrulama ve dokümantasyon disiplinin varsa, - Müşteri lokasyonunda zaman geçirmeye açıksan. Tercih Sebebi: - SAP, Logo, Netsis, Mikro gibi ERP ve muhasebe sistemleriyle entegrasyon deneyimi. - Fintech, kurumsal kart, ödeme veya harcama yönetimi alanında deneyim. - Masraf, seyahat ya da satın alma süreçlerine hâkimiyet. - Agent, MCP sunucusu veya otomasyon akışı kurmuş olmak. Başarıyı Nasıl Ölçeriz? - Kurulum ve canlıya geçiş süresi. - Talep ve hata kapanış süresi. - Müşteri memnuniyeti. - Ürüne dönüşen saha talepleri. Çalışma Şekli: İstanbul, hibrit, tam zamanlı. Masraff'ta neler sunuyoruz? - Tamamlayıcı sağlık sigortası. - Hoş geldin izni. - MultiSport üyeliği. - Yemek kartı. - Samimi, enerjik ve iş birliğine dayalı bir kültür. - Sürekli gelişim. Bize Katılmak İster Misiniz? Başvururken canlıya aldığın bir kurulum ya da entegrasyonu kısaca anlat: Ne kurdun, en çok neyi zorladın ve sonucu nasıl ölçtün? Başvuru: https://www.masraff.co/tr/careers/forward-deployed-engineer/

title: Database Administrator (DBA)
description: Your Next Chapter Starts Here We're looking for Database Administrator to join our fast-moving, collaborative team and help build enterprise-level products for both local and global markets. You'll work closely with consultants, product owners, designers, QA, and developers across mobile, backend, and frontend to bring great digital products to life. How you’ll contribute: Managing installation, configuration, maintenance and day-to-day operations of SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases across dev, test, UAT, production and DR environments Running high-availability architectures, mainly SQL Server Always On Availability Groups and PostgreSQL Patroni clusters, and keeping them healthy and ready for failover Planning and executing upgrades, migrations, patching and version transitions, including safe, controlled modernization of legacy systems Owning backup, restore, PITR, log shipping and DR processes in line with RPO/RTO targets, and planning, running and reporting the annual DR tests Analyzing and tuning performance (execution plans, Query Store, Extended Events, DMVs, wait statistics, blocking, deadlocks, pg_stat_statements, vacuum and bloat) Optimizing stored procedures and complex queries, and setting SQL coding, review and change standards together with the development teams Monitoring and improving CDC and logical replication pipelines (replication slots, WAL retention, lag, data consistency) Building a central PostgreSQL toolkit covering inventory, health, backups, replication, CDC status, maintenance and alerting Automating repetitive operational work with scripts, jobs and self-service tooling Owning database change, incident and problem management end to end, including root cause analysis, rollback plans and post-incident reports Proactively monitoring and preparing for peak business periods such as month-end and month-start Working closely with application, system, network, security, DevOps and data teams What makes you the one: A candidate with 3+ years of professional DBA experience and a degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering or a related field, with the following skills: Advanced administration of Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL Hands-on experience with SQL Server Always On AG, synchronous/asynchronous replication, log shipping and DR/failover/failback processes Strong SQL Server performance tuning skills (execution plans, Query Store, wait statistics, index and statistics maintenance, blocking and deadlock analysis) Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL backup and recovery, WAL, vacuum/autovacuum and replication Hands-on experience with Patroni-based HA (failover, switchover, replica management, pg_rewind) Advanced knowledge of PostgreSQL logical replication and CDC processes Database security: role and permission management, least privilege, auditing, SSL/TLS, TDE and data encryption Linux administration and automation with Bash or Python Experience working with monitoring and alerting tools Strong technical documentation skills and the ability to write operational runbooks The adesso Experience: Flexible hybrid working model: Remote and in-office, based on your role and team. Be part of cross-border projects and global teams while staying based in Turkey. Lean structure with efficient, optimized work processes. Competitive salary, private health insurance, and a comprehensive benefits package. Performance-based bonus tied to both company results and individual contributions. Continuous learning through unlimited Udemy access and the adesso Group learning platform. A dedicated wellbeing platform with access to therapists, personal trainers, and health advisers. A unique working culture that goes beyond the desk: social clubs, team rituals, regional meetups, New Year's parties, C-level coffees, workshops, and company-wide events that bring everyone together. More about adesso Turkey adesso Turkey empowers organizations through custom software development and IT consultancy. We deliver the finest-caliber digital solutions, transforming businesses, people, and technology. Our group headquarters are in Dortmund, Germany, and we have over 11,100 colleagues working at 65 sites worldwide. Check out www.adesso.com.tr for more information.
